items.caption: A Shang oracle-script-style form of 少, shown here as a modern vector depiction. Early spellings transcribed as 少 or 小 overlap in shape and use; the strokes’ referent remains uncertain.
items.alt: Four separate black strokes on white: one long vertical oval above, two shorter strokes at the sides, and a short slanting stroke below.
items.selection_reason: The form illustrates the reported early graphic overlap between 少 and 小. Its appearance alone does not establish what the strokes depict; the grain interpretation is one proposal.

limitations.text: This is a modern vector depiction, not an artifact photograph, and no artifact date is established for the specific form shown. Early 少 and 小 spellings overlap; whether the strokes depict grains or something else remains unresolved.
